questions: Decompose full-split SR/SPL changes into rescue, harm, both_success_changed, both_success_unchanged, both_failure.
Measure observed historical success coverage and rescue fraction; distinguish actual decision nodes from standard path oracle.
Stratify all instructions by baseline success, exact termination flag combinations, full decision-history size, baseline endpoint age, current-ending success, baseline STOP confidence, and scene.
Describe selected endpoint age, legal move count, baseline STOP probability and return costs within each fixed outcome category.
Compare M versus C3 endpoint outcomes on the identical frozen histories.
Report training manifest counts for natural, forced-control and paired data without claiming distribution causality or reading feature tensors.
scope: Read-only descriptive full-split analysis. No new navigation, model fitting, score re-ranking, threshold search, selected-example search, or checkpoint selection.
missing_evidence: E1 reports omit head logits, so head score margins, calibration and confidence cannot be recovered.
S1 stores decision statistics but no token embeddings; feature comparability across time is an architectural hypothesis, not an empirical finding.
S1 minimum-return oracle describes opportunities only; no oracle method score is reported.
Training manifests contain aggregate rollout/state counts but no comparable per-state confidence or success distribution.
